*No common parameters.*

Sort by update_time and commission_id in descending order by default.&nbsp;Available values:commission_rate: Sort by commission_rate in ascending order-commission_rate: Sort by commission_rate in descending order |

| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ icms_cst | string | |  | Only for BR shop.ICMS - Imposto sobre Circulação de Mercadorias e Serviços (Circulation of Goods and Services Tax).&nbsp;CST - Código da Situação Tributária (Tax Situation Code) is represented by a combination of 3 numbers with the purpose of demonstrating the origin of a product and determining the form of taxation that will apply to it. For more information, please visit the market's respective Seller Education Hub. |

| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ ncm | string | |  | Mercosur Common Nomenclature, it is a convention between Mercosur member countries to easily recognize goods, services and productive factors negotiated among themselves.&nbsp;(BR region)NCM must have 8 digits, OR, if your item doesn't have a NCM enter the value "00" |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ same_state_cfop | string | |  | Tax Code of Operations and Installments for orders that seller and buyer are in the same state. It identifies a specific operation by category at the time of issuing the invoice.(BR region) |

| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ origin | string | |  | Product source, domestic or foreig (BR region).\|0 - National, except for those indicated in codes 3, 4, 5, and 8\| \|1 - Foreign: Direct import, except for that indicated in code 6\| \|2 - Foreign: Acquired in the domestic market, except for that indicated in code 7\| \|3 - National: Goods or products with Import Content greater than 40% and less than or equal to 70%\| \|4 - National: Produced in compliance with the basic production processes outlined in the legislations cited in the Agreements\| \|5 - National: Goods or products with Import Content less than or equal to 40%\| \|6 - Foreign: Direct import, without a national equivalent, listed by CAMEX and natural gas\| \|7 - Foreign: Acquired in the domestic market, without a national equivalent, listed by CAMEX and natural gas\| \|8 - National: Goods or products with Import Content greater than 70%\| |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ cest | string | |  | Tax Replacement Specifying Code (CEST), to separate within the same NCM products that do or do not have ICMS tax substitution. (BR region)CEST must have 7 digits, OR, if your item doesn't have a CEST enter the value "00". |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ measure_unit | string | |  | (BR region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tax_type | int32 | |  | tax_type only for TW whitelist shop. Shopee will referred Tax type when substitute sellers for issuing e-receipts to buyers. All variations share the same tax type. The meaning of value:&nbsp;0: no tax type1: tax-able2: tax-free |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pis | string | |  | Only for BR shop.PIS - Programa de Integração Social (Social Integration Program). It is a government tax to collect resources for the payment of unemployment insurance and other employee related rights.PIS % - the tax applied to this product |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ cofins | string | |  | Only for BR shop.COFINS – Contribuição para Financiamento da Seguridade Social (Contribution for Social Security Funding). It&nbsp;is a government tax to collect resources for public health system and social security.COFINS&nbsp;% - the tax applied to this product |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ icms_cst | string | |  | Only for BR shop.ICMS - Imposto sobre Circulação de Mercadorias e Serviços (Circulation of Goods and Services Tax).&nbsp;CST - Código da Situação Tributária (Tax Situation Code) is represented by a combination of 3 numbers with the purpose of demonstrating the origin of a product and determining the form of taxation that will apply to it. Therefore, each digit in the CST Table has a specific meaning: the first digit indicates the origin of the operation, the second digit represents the ICMS taxation on the operation and the third digit provides additional information about the form of taxation. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pis_cofins_cst | string | |  | Only for BR shop.The CST PIS/Cofins is a code on the Electronic Invoice (NF-e) that identifies the tax situation of PIS (Programa de Integração Social) and Cofins (Contribuição para o Financiamento da Seguridade Social) in sales of goods. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ federal_state_taxes | string | |  | Only for BR shop.Enter the total percentage of the combination of federal, state, and municipal taxes, using up to two decimals. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ operation_type | string | |  | Only for BR shop.1: Retailer2: Manufacturer |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ ex_tipi | string | |  | Only for BR shop.The EXTIPI field in the NF-e (Nota Fiscal Eletrônica) is used to indicate if there's an exception to the IPI (Imposto sobre Produtos Industrializados) tax rate for a specific product. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ fci_num | string | |  | Only for BR shop.The FCI Control Number is a unique identifier assigned to each import FCI (Import Content Form). It's mandatory on the corresponding NF-e (electronic invoice) to ensure compliance with Brazilian import tax regulations. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ recopi_num | string | |  | Only for BR shop.RECOPI NACIONAL is a Brazilian government system that facilitates the registration and management of tax-exempt operations involving paper destined for printing books, newspapers, and periodicals (known as "papel imune" in Portuguese). |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ additional_info | string | |  | Only for BR shop.Include relevant information to display on Invoice. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ group_item_info | object | |  | Only for BR shop.Required if the item is a group item. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ group_qtd | string | |  | Example: The package contains 6 soda cans. Whether you are selling a pack of 6 cans (fardo) or a single can (unit), enter 6. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ group_unit | string | |  | Example: The package contains 6 soda cans. Whether you are selling a pack of 6 cans (fardo) or a single can (unit), enter UNI for the individual can. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ group_unit_value | string | |  | Example: The package contains 6 soda cans. Whether you are selling a pack of 6 cans (fardo) or a single can (unity), enter the value of the individual can. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ original_group_price | string | |  | Example: The item is a package that contains 6 soda cans. Enter the price of the whole package. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ group_gtin_sscc | string | |  | Example: The item is a package that contains 6 soda cans. Please inform the GTIN SSCC code for the package. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ group_grai_gtin_sscc | string | |  | Example: The item is box, that contain 6 packages. Each package contains 6 soda cans. Please inform the GRAI GTIN SSCC code for the Box. |

### v2.product.update_item

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/product/update_item`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/update_item  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/update_item  

**Description:** Update item.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |

| weight | float | ❌ No | 0.9 | The weight of this item, the unit is KG.Updating the weight of this item will overwrite the weight of all models under this item. |
| pre_order | object | ❌ No |  | Pre Order setting. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ days_to_ship | int32 | | 7 | Days to ship. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ is_pre_order | boolean | | false | Whether the item is pre order. |

| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ value_id | int32 | | 38173 | ID of attribute value. In the following cases, the value id needs to be uploaded as 0, and original_value_name is mandatory, needs to be filled in customized value. (1) AttributeInputType is TEXT_FILED; (2) AttributeInputType is COMBO_BOX or MULTIPLE_SELECT_COMBO_BOX, and the seller want to fill in a customized value. |

| tax_info | object | ❌ No |  | Tax information |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ ncm | string | |  | Mercosur Common Nomenclature, it is a convention between Mercosur member countries to easily recognize goods, services and productive factors negotiated among themselves.&nbsp;(BR region)NCM must have 8 digits, OR, if your item doesn't have a NCM enter the value "00" |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ same_state_cfop | string | |  | Tax Code of Operations and Installments for orders that seller and buyer are in the same state. It identifies a specific operation by category at the time of issuing the invoice. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ diff_state_cfop | string | |  | Tax Code of Operations and Installments for orders that seller and buyer are in different states. It identifies a specific operation by category at the time of issuing the invoice. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ csosn | string | |  | Code of Operation Status – Simples Nacional, code for company operations to identify the origin of the goods and the taxation regime of the operations. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ origin | string | |  | Product source, domestic or foreig |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ cest | string | |  | Tax Replacement Specifying Code (CEST), to separate within the same NCM products that do or do not have ICMS tax substitution. (BR region)CEST must have 7 digits, OR, if your item doesn't have a CEST enter the value "00". |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ measure_unit | string | |  | (BR region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ invoice_option | string | |  | Value shuold be one of NO_INVOICES VAT_MARGIN_SCHEME_INVOICES VAT_INVOICES NON_VAT_INVOICES and if value is NON_VAT_INVOICE vat_rate should be null (PL region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ vat_rate | string | |  | Value should be one of 0% 5% 8% 23% NO_VAT_RATE (PL region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ hs_code | string | |  | HS Code. (Only for IN region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tax_code | string | |  | Tax Code. (Only for IN region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tax_type | int32 | |  | tax_type only for TW whitelist shop. Shopee will referred Tax type when substitute sellers for issuing e-receipts to buyers. All variations share the same tax type. The meaning of value:&nbsp;0: no tax type1: tax-able2: tax-free |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pis | string | |  | Only for BR shop.PIS - Programa de Integração Social (Social Integration Program). It is a government tax to collect resources for the payment of unemployment insurance and other employee related rights.PIS % - the tax applied to this product |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ cofins | string | |  | Only for BR shop.COFINS – Contribuição para Financiamento da Seguridade Social (Contribution for Social Security Funding). It&nbsp;is a government tax to collect resources for public health system and social security.COFINS&nbsp;% - the tax applied to this product |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ icms_cst | string | |  | Only for BR shop.ICMS - Imposto sobre Circulação de Mercadorias e Serviços (Circulation of Goods and Services Tax).&nbsp;CST - Código da Situação Tributária (Tax Situation Code) is represented by a combination of 3 numbers with the purpose of demonstrating the origin of a product and determining the form of taxation that will apply to it. Therefore, each digit in the CST Table has a specific meaning: the first digit indicates the origin of the operation, the second digit represents the ICMS taxation on the operation and the third digit provides additional information about the form of taxation. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pis_cofins_cst | string | |  | Only for BR shop.The CST PIS/Cofins is a code on the Electronic Invoice (NF-e) that identifies the tax situation of PIS (Programa de Integração Social) and Cofins (Contribuição para o Financiamento da Seguridade Social) in sales of goods. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ federal_state_taxes | string | |  | Only for BR shop.Enter the total percentage of the combination of federal, state, and municipal taxes, using up to two decimals. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ operation_type | string | |  | Only for BR shop.1: Retailer2: Manufacturer |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ ex_tipi | string | |  | Only for BR shop.The EXTIPI field in the NF-e (Nota Fiscal Eletrônica) is used to indicate if there's an exception to the IPI (Imposto sobre Produtos Industrializados) tax rate for a specific product. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ fci_num | string | |  | Only for BR shop.The FCI Control Number is a unique identifier assigned to each import FCI (Import Content Form). It's mandatory on the corresponding NF-e (electronic invoice) to ensure compliance with Brazilian import tax regulations. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ recopi_num | string | |  | Only for BR shop.RECOPI NACIONAL is a Brazilian government system that facilitates the registration and management of tax-exempt operations involving paper destined for printing books, newspapers, and periodicals (known as "papel imune" in Portuguese). |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ additional_info | string | |  | Only for BR shop.Include relevant information to display on Invoice. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ group_item_info | object | |  | Only for BR shop.Required if the item is a group item. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ group_qtd | string | |  | Example: The package contains 6 soda cans. Whether you are selling a pack of 6 cans (fardo) or a single can (unit), enter 6. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ group_unit | string | |  | Example: The package contains 6 soda cans. Whether you are selling a pack of 6 cans (fardo) or a single can (unit), enter UNI for the individual can. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ group_unit_value | string | |  | Example: The package contains 6 soda cans. Whether you are selling a pack of 6 cans (fardo) or a single can (unity), enter the value of the individual can. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ original_group_price | string | |  | Example: The item is a package that contains 6 soda cans. Enter the price of the whole package. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ group_gtin_sscc | string | |  | Example: The item is a package that contains 6 soda cans. Please inform the GTIN SSCC code for the package. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ group_grai_gtin_sscc | string | |  | Example: The item is box, that contain 6 packages. Each package contains 6 soda cans. Please inform the GRAI GTIN SSCC code for the Box. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ export_cfop | string | |  | 7101 - for sales of self-produced goods7102 - resale of third-party goods |

The most common are UPC, EAN, JAN and ISBN.- GTIN will help boost positioning in online marketing channels like Google and Facebook.- That incorporation with GTIN will also aid in Search and Recommendation in Shopee itself allowing buyers to have higher likelihood of finding one's listing.Note: If you want to set “Item without GTIN”, please pass the gtin_code as "00".The validation rule is based on the value return in gtin_validation_rule" field in v2.product.get_item_limit API- Mandatory:&nbsp;This field is required and must contain a correctly formatted GTiN number.- Flexible: This field is required and must contain either a correctly formatted GTlN number or "00" to declare that the item/model has no valid GTlN.- Optional: This field is optional and can contain a correctly formatted GTiN number, "00" or be omitted entirely. |

### v2.product.init_tier_variation

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/product/init_tier_variation`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/init_tier_variation  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/init_tier_variation  

**Description:** This API allows you to update the tier structure of a product. Defining only color creates one tier, while color + size creates two tiers (maximum supported). Supported changes include: no tier ↔ one/two tiers, one tier ↔ two/no tier, and two tiers ↔ one/no tier. For details, see Developer Guide. Please wait at least 5 seconds after creating an item before creating variants, as processing may be delayed.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| item_id | int64 | ✅ Yes | 1000 | ID of item |
| model | object[] | ✅ Yes |  | Model info list, model number at most 50 |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tier_index | int32[] | | [0] | Tier index of this model.If you want to update one tier/two tier to no tier, can just pass the tier_variation and standardise_tier_variation as [], and pass the model &gt;&gt; tier_index as [], meanwhile pass the original_price, seller_stock, etc., to set the price and stock for the modified product with no tier structure. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ original_price | float | | 38.3 | Original price of this model.For CO local VAT responsible seller：Please remember the price you set in here must be VAT inclusive. If you have any doubts on how to calculate VAT for your product please refer to the Seller Education Hub（https://seller.shopee.com.co/edu/article/13565） |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ model_sku | string | | SKU | Seller SKU of this model, model_sku length information needs to be no more than 100 characters. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ seller_stock | object[] | |  | new stock info（Please notice that stock(including Seller Stock and Shopee Stock) should be larger than or equal to real-time reserved stock） |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ location_id | string | |  | location id, you can get the location id from v2.shop.get_warehouse_detail api, if seller don't have any warehouse, you don't need to upload this field. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ stock | int32 | |  | stock |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ gtin_code | string | |  | - GTIN is an identifier for trade items, developed by the international organization GS1.- They have 8 to 14 digits. The most common are UPC, EAN, JAN and ISBN.- GTIN will help boost positioning in online marketing channels like Google and Facebook.- That incorporation with GTIN will also aid in Search and Recommendation in Shopee itself allowing buyers to have higher likelihood of finding one's listing.Note: If you want to set “Item without GTIN”, please pass the gtin_code as "00".The validation rule is based on the value return in gtin_validation_rule" field in v2.product.get_item_limit API- Mandatory:&nbsp;This field is required and must contain a correctly formatted GTiN number.- Flexible: This field is required and must contain either a correctly formatted GTlN number or "00" to declare that the item/model has no valid GTlN.- Optional: This field is optional and can contain a correctly formatted GTiN number, "00" or be omitted entirely. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ weight | float | | 1.1 | The weight of this model, the unit is KG.If don't set the weight of this model, will use the weight of item by default.If set the dimension of this model, them must set the weight of this model. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ dimension | object | |  | The dimension of this model.If don't set the dimension of this model, will use the dimension of item by default. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_height | int32 | | 11 | The height of package for this model, the unit is CM. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_length | int32 | | 11 | The length of package for this model, the unit is CM. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_width | int32 | | 11 | The width of package for this model, the unit is CM. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pre_order | object | |  | Pre-order information of this model.Notes:&nbsp;If don't set the DTS of this model, will use the DTS of the item by default. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ is_pre_order | boolean | | false | Whether the model is pre order. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ days_to_ship | int32 | | 2 | Days to ship. Please get the days_to_ship range from the get_dts_limit API. |
| standardise_tier_variation | object[] | ❌ No |  | There is at least one standardise_tier_variation and&nbsp;tier_variation.If you want to update one tier/two tier to no tier, can just pass the tier_variation and standardise_tier_variation as [], and pass the model &gt;&gt; tier_index as [], meanwhile pass the original_price, seller_stock, etc., to set the price and stock for the modified product with no tier structure. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ variation_id | int32 | | 1 | standardise tier variation ID. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ variation_name | string | | name1 | standardise tier variation name |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ variation_group_id | int32 | | 2 | standardise tier variation group ID |

| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ variation_option_id | int32 | |  | standardise tier variation option ID. |

### v2.product.add_model

**Method:** `GET`

**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/add_model  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/add_model  

**Description:** Add model. More detail please check: https://open.shopee.com/developer-guide/219  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| item_id | int64 | ✅ Yes | 1000 | ID of item |
| model_list | object[] | ✅ Yes |  | Model list |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tier_index | int32[] | | [0] | Tier index of model |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ original_price | float | | 38.3 | Normal stock for price |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ model_sku | string | | SKU | Seller sku, model_sku length information needs to be no more than 100 characters. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ seller_stock | object[] | |  | new stock info for model（Please notice that stock(including Seller Stock and Shopee Stock) should be larger than or equal to real-time reserved stock） |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ location_id | string | |  | location id,&nbsp;you can get the location id from v2.shop.get_warehouse_detail api, if seller don't have any warehouse, you don't need to upload this field. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ stock | int32 | |  | stock |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ gtin_code | string | |  | - GTIN is an identifier for trade items, developed by the international organization GS1.- They have 8 to 14 digits. The most common are UPC, EAN, JAN and ISBN.- GTIN will help boost positioning in online marketing channels like Google and Facebook.- That incorporation with GTIN will also aid in Search and Recommendation in Shopee itself allowing buyers to have higher likelihood of finding one's listing.Note: If you want to set “Item without GTIN”, please pass the gtin_code as "00".The validation rule is based on the value return in gtin_validation_rule" field in v2.product.get_item_limit API- Mandatory:&nbsp;This field is required and must contain a correctly formatted GTiN number.- Flexible: This field is required and must contain either a correctly formatted GTlN number or "00" to declare that the item/model has no valid GTlN.- Optional: This field is optional and can contain a correctly formatted GTiN number, "00" or be omitted entirely. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ weight | float | | 1.1 | The weight of this model, the unit is KG.If don't set the weight of this model, will use the weight of item by default.If set the dimension of this model, them must set the weight of this model. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ dimension | object | |  | The dimension of this model.If don't set the dimension of this model, will use the dimension of item by default. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_height | int32 | | 11 | The height of package for this model, the unit is CM. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_length | int32 | | 11 | The length of package for this model, the unit is CM. |

### v2.product.update_stock

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/product/update_stock`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/update_stock  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/update_stock  

**Description:** Use this API to update one item_id for each call, but still can support updating multiple model_ids stock of the same item_id (If you need batch modification, please call multiple times)This API will update only "seller_stock".Whenever there is a promotion ongoing or upcoming, the total stock must be larger than or equal to real-time “reserved_stock” promotion stock (Please check v2.get_item_promotion API for more details). Items that are deleted will not be allowed to modify stock.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| item_id | int64 | ✅ Yes | 1000 | ID of item. |
| stock_list | object[] | ✅ Yes |  | Length should be between 1 to 50. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ model_id | int64 | |  | 0 for no model item. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ seller_stock | object[] | |  | new stock info（Please notice that stock(including Seller Stock and Shopee Stock) should be larger than or equal to real-time reserved stock） |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ location_id | string | |  | location id, you can get the location id from v2.shop.get_warehouse_detail api, if seller don't have any warehouse, you don't need to upload this field. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ stock | int64 | |  | stock |

#### Response Parameters

| Name | Type | Sample | Description |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| error | string |  | Indicate error type if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| message | string |  | Indicate error details if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| warning | string |  | Warning message. |
| request_id | string |  | The identifier for an API request for error tracking. |
| response | object |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ failure_list | object[] | |  | Fail model list. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ model_id | int64 | |  | ID of model. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ failed_reason | string | |  | Reason for failure. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ success_list | object[] | |  | Success model list. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ model_id | int64 | |  | ID of model. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ location_id | string | |  | location id; This field and the stock field are returned in pairs |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ stock | int64 | |  | stock;This field is returned if seller stock is used in the request, and normal stock fields are not returned. |

For more information, please visit the market's respective Seller Education Hub. |

| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ ncm | string | |  | Mercosur Common Nomenclature, it is a convention between Mercosur member countries to easily recognize goods, services and productive factors negotiated among themselves.&nbsp;(BR region)NCM must have 8 digits, OR, if your item doesn't have a NCM enter the value "00" |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ same_state_cfop | string | |  | Tax Code of Operations and Installments for orders that seller and buyer are in the same state. It identifies a specific operation by category at the time of issuing the invoice.(BR region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ diff_state_cfop | string | |  | Tax Code of Operations and Installments for orders that seller and buyer are in different states. It identifies a specific operation by category at the time of issuing the invoice.(BR region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ csosn | string | |  | Code of Operation Status – Simples Nacional, code for company operations to identify the origin of the goods and the taxation regime of the operations.(BR region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ origin | string | |  | Product source, domestic or foreig (BR region). |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ cest | string | |  | Tax Replacement Specifying Code (CEST), to separate within the same NCM products that do or do not have ICMS tax substitution. (BR region)CEST must have 7 digits, OR, if your item doesn't have a CEST enter the value "00". |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ measure_unit | string | |  | (BR region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ invoice_option | string | |  | Value shuold be one of NO_INVOICES VAT_MARGIN_SCHEME_INVOICES VAT_INVOICES NON_VAT_INVOICES and if value is NON_VAT_INVOICE vat_rate should be null (PL region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ vat_rate | string | |  | Value should be one of 0% 5% 8% 23% NO_VAT_RATE (PL region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ hs_code | string | |  | HS Code (Only for IN region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tax_code | string | |  | Tax Code (Only for IN region) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tax_type | int32 | |  | tax_type only for TW whitelist shop. Shopee will referred Tax type when substitute sellers for issuing e-receipts to buyers. All variations share the same tax type. The meaning of value:&nbsp;0: no tax type1: tax-able2: tax-free |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pis | string | |  | Only for BR shop.PIS - Programa de Integração Social (Social Integration Program). It is a government tax to collect resources for the payment of unemployment insurance and other employee related rights.PIS % - the tax applied to this product |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ cofins | string | |  | Only for BR shop.COFINS – Contribuição para Financiamento da Seguridade Social (Contribution for Social Security Funding). It&nbsp;is a government tax to collect resources for public health system and social security.COFINS&nbsp;% - the tax applied to this product |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ icms_cst | string | |  | Only for BR shop.ICMS - Imposto sobre Circulação de Mercadorias e Serviços (Circulation of Goods and Services Tax).&nbsp;CST - Código da Situação Tributária (Tax Situation Code) is represented by a combination of 3 numbers with the purpose of demonstrating the origin of a product and determining the form of taxation that will apply to it. Therefore, each digit in the CST Table has a specific meaning: the first digit indicates the origin of the operation, the second digit represents the ICMS taxation on the operation and the third digit provides additional information about the form of taxation. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pis_cofins_cst | string | |  | Only for BR shop.The CST PIS/Cofins is a code on the Electronic Invoice (NF-e) that identifies the tax situation of PIS (Programa de Integração Social) and Cofins (Contribuição para o Financiamento da Seguridade Social) in sales of goods. |

| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ operation_type | string | |  | Only for BR shop.1: Retailer2: Manufacturer |

| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ fci_num | string | |  | Only for BR shop.The FCI Control Number is a unique identifier assigned to each import FCI (Import Content Form). It's mandatory on the corresponding NF-e (electronic invoice) to ensure compliance with Brazilian import tax regulations. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ recopi_num | string | |  | Only for BR shop.RECOPI NACIONAL is a Brazilian government system that facilitates the registration and management of tax-exempt operations involving paper destined for printing books, newspapers, and periodicals (known as "papel imune" in Portuguese). |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ additional_info | string | |  | Only for BR shop.Include relevant information to display on Invoice. |

### v2.global_product.init_tier_variation

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/global_product/init_tier_variation`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/global_product/init_tier_variation  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/global_product/init_tier_variation  

**Description:** Only for China mainland sellers and Korean sellers. If you only define color, it is one tier, if you define color and size, it is two tier. Support two tier structures at most. This API can change no tier to one tier, no tier to two tier, one tier to two tier, two tier to one tier, one tier to no tier, two tier to no tier. Please create variants after an interval of 5 seconds after creating an item, as there may be a delay.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| global_model | object[] | ✅ Yes |  | Model info list, model number at most 50 |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ original_price | float | | 12.34 | Original price of global model. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ seller_stock | object[] | |  | seller_stock of global item |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ location_id | string | | CNZ | location_id of stock, if the merchant has 3PF shop, the location_id cannot be empty, can use the&nbsp;get_merchant_warehouse_location_list&nbsp;API to obtain the location_id list of the merchant, if the merchant does not have 3PF shop (only has normal CBSC shop), the location_id can be empty |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ stock | int64 | | 100 | stock |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ global_model_sku | string | | sku | Sku of global model. model_sku length information needs to be no more than 100 characters. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tier_index | int32[] | | [0,1] | Tier index of global model. Index starts from 0.If you want to update one tier/two tier to no tier, can just pass the tier_variation and standardise_tier_variation as [], and pass the global_model &gt;&gt; tier_index as [], meanwhile pass the original_price, seller_stock, etc., to set the price and stock for the modified product with no tier structure. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ weight | float | | 1.1 | The weight of this global model, the unit is KG.If don't set the weight of this global model, will use the weight of global item by default.If set the dimension of this global model, them must set the weight of this global model. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ dimension | object | |  | The dimension of this global model.If don't set the dimension of this global model, will use the dimension of global item by default. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_height | int32 | | 11 | The height of package for this global model, the unit is CM. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_length | int32 | | 11 | The length of package for this global model, the unit is CM. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_width | int32 | | 11 | The width of package for this global model, the unit is CM. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pre_order | object | |  | Pre-order information of this global model.Notes:&nbsp;If don't set the DTS of this global model, will use the DTS of the global item by default. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ days_to_ship | int32 | | 2 | Days to ship. Please get the days_to_ship range from the get_dts_limit API. |
| global_item_id | int32 | ✅ Yes | 22001469 | ID of global item. |
| standardise_tier_variation | object[] | ❌ No |  | There is at least one standardise_tier_variation and&nbsp;tier_variation.If you want to update one tier/two tier to no tier, can just pass the tier_variation and standardise_tier_variation as [], and pass the global_model &gt;&gt; tier_index as [], meanwhile pass the original_price, seller_stock, etc., to set the price and stock for the modified product with no tier structure. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ variation_id | int32 | |  | standardise tier variation ID |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ variation_name | string | |  | standardise tier variation name |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ variation_group_id | int32 | |  | standardise tier variation group ID |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ variation_option_list | object[] | |  | standardise tier variation option list |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ variation_option_id | int32 | |  | standardise tier variation option ID |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ variation_option_name | string | |  | standardise tier variation option value |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ image_id | string | |  | standardise tier variation option image ID |

### v2.media.get_video_upload_result

**Method:** `POST`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/media/get_video_upload_result`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/media/get_video_upload_result  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/media/get_video_upload_result  

**Description:** Use this API to retrieve the current status and result of a video upload task. You can also use video_upload_result_push to get notified immediately when a video upload reaches a final status (SUCCEEDED, FAILED, or CANCELLED).  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| video_upload_id | string | ✅ Yes | sg-11110201-6kh48-mepm7a0ttcw3c3 | The unique ID of the upload task, returned by v2.media.init_video_upload. |

#### Response Parameters

| Name | Type | Sample | Description |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| error | string |  | Indicate error type if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| message | string |  | Indicate error details if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| warning | string |  | Indicate warning message you should take care. |
| request_id | string | e3e3e7f33ee88a7454c64e7a0b546e01 | The identifier for an API request for error tracking. |
| response | object |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ status | string | | SUCCEEDED | Current status of the upload task. Possible values:- INITIATED: Upload task has been created (via init_video_upload) but no parts have been uploaded yet.- UPLOADING: Video file parts are being uploaded. The upload has started but is not yet completed.- UPLOADED: All video parts have been uploaded successfully, waiting for complete_video_upload to trigger processing.- PROCESSING: Video is being transcoded/validated by the system (duration, format, resolution checks).- SUCCEEDED: Video upload and transcoding completed successfully. Video URL and cover URL are available for use.- FAILED: Upload or processing failed (e.g., invalid format, duration not within allowed range, transcoding error).- CANCELLED: Upload task was explicitly canceled by the client (cancel_video_upload), and the video is discarded. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ reason | string | |  | Detailed fail or cancel reason, will be returned if status is FAILED or CANCELLED. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ update_time | timestamp | | 1758018336 | The time of video status updates. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ video_info | object | |  | Transcoded video info, will be returned if status is SUCCEEDED. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ video_url | string | | http://play-src.vod.shopee.com/api/v4/11110201/mms/sg-11110201-6kh48-mepm7a0ttcw3c3. | Video playback url. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ video_thumbnail_url | string | | http://img.sp.mms.shopee.sg/sg-11110201-6kh48-mepm7a0ttcw3c3_cover | Video thumbnail image url. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ thumbnail_width | int32 | | 1920 | Video thumbnail image width. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ thumbnail_height | int32 | | 1080 | Video thumbnail image width. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ duration | int32 | | 105 | Video duration in seconds. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ resolution | string | | 960x540 | Video resolution, e.g., "1280x1280". |

### v2.order.get_shipment_list

**Method:** `POST`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/order/get_shipment_list`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/order/get_shipment_list  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/order/get_shipment_list  

**Description:** Use this api to get order list which order_status is READY_TO_SHIP or RETRY_SHIP to start process the whole shipping progress.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| cursor | string | ❌ No | "" | Specifies the starting entry of data to return in the current call. Default is "". If data is more than one page, the offset can be some entry to start next call. |
| page_size | int32 | ✅ Yes | 20 | Each result set is returned as a page of entries. Use the "page_size" filters to control the maximum number of entries to retrieve per page (i.e., per call). This integer value is used to specify the maximum number of entries to return in a single "page" of data.The limit of page_size if between 1 and 100. |

#### Response Parameters

| Name | Type | Sample | Description |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| error | string | common.error_auth | Indicate error type if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| message | string | Invalid access_token. | Indicate error details if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| response | object |  | Detail informations you are querying. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ order_list | object[] | |  | The list of shipment orders |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ order_sn | string | | 2003160SXK2A3T | Shopee's unique identifier for an order. |

### v2.order.search_package_list

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/order/search_package_list`

**Description:** Use this API to search the list of packages that have not been SHIPPED to proceed arranging shipment, and it supports various filters and sort fields.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |

| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ product_location_ids | string[] | | ["VN0005EIZ"] | List of product_location_id. Use this field to filter the packages under specific warehouses. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ logistics_channel_ids | int32[] | | [50021] | List of logistics_channel_id. Use this field to filter the packages under specific logistics channels. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ fulfillment_type | int32 | | 2 | Use this field to filter the packages fulfilled by shopee or seller. Applicable values:&nbsp;0: None (not apply filter)1: Shopee2: SellerDefault value = 2 (Seller) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ invoice_pending | boolean | | false | Use this field to filter the packages under invoice_pending.Default value = false |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ sorting_group | int32 | | 1 | [Only for TW 30029 channel] Use this field to filter the sorting group of parcel. This field is only available for package with package_status = 3 and logistics_channel_id = 30029. Applicable values:&nbsp;0: All1: North2: South |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ order_type | int32 | | 0 | Use this field to filter packages by order type. Applicable values:0: All1: Regular Order2: Instant OrderDefault value = 0 (All)Note:&nbsp;For VN shops, using 2: Instant Order will return both Instant Delivery and Same-day Delivery packages. |

| pagination | object | ✅ Yes |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ page_size | int32 | | 5 | Each result set is returned as a page of entries. Use the "page_size" filters to control the maximum number of entries to retrieve per page (i.e., per call). This integer value is used to specify the maximum number of entries to return in a single "page" of data.The limit of page_size if between 1 and 100. |

| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ sort_type | int32 | | 1 | Use this field to specify which field to use to sort the returned package list. Available values:&nbsp;1: ShipByDate&nbsp;&nbsp;2: CreateDate3: ConfirmedDateDefault value = 1 (ShipByDate) |

### v2.order.split_order

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/order/split_order`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/order/split_order  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/order/split_order  

**Description:** Use this api to split an order into multiple packages. Orders that include installation services cannot be split by quantity.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| order_sn | string | ✅ Yes | 2012300NQJVTYN | Shopee's unique identifier for an order. |
| package_list | object[] | ✅ Yes |  | The list of packages that you want to split.&nbsp;Note:&nbsp;- Orders that include installation services cannot be split by quantity.- When splitting the order, must contain all items in the order in one request.- You can split the order into 30 parcels at most in TW and 5 parcels at most in other regions. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ item_list | object[] | |  | The list of items under the same package. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ item_id | int64 | | 3600140554 | Shopee's unique identifier for an item. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ model_id | int64 | | 10000605797 | Shopee's unique identifier for a model of an item. For single item without variation, you can set model_id as 0. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ order_item_id | int | |  | The identify of order item. For items in one same bundle deal promotion, the order_item_id should share the same id, such as 1,2. For items not in bundle deal promotion, the order_item_id should be the same as item_id. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ promotion_group_id | int | |  | The identify of product promotion.It's required for add on deal and bundle deal items.For items in one same add on deal or bundle deal promotion, the promotion_group_id should share the same id. For items not in add on deal or bundle deal promotion, the promotion_group_id should be 0. And the data is from promotion_group_id of v2,order.get_order_detail. |

### v2.order.generate_fbs_invoices

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/order/generate_fbs_invoices`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/order/generate_fbs_invoices  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/order/generate_fbs_invoices  

**Description:** This API creates a task to download a specific tax document (e.g., sales invoice, remessa invoice) for the seller's account, available only after the document is issued by the system as part of the Fulfilled by Shopee (FBS) process. The workflow is as follows: (1) v2.order.generate_fbs_invoices; (2) v2.order.get_fbs_invoices_result; (3) v2.order.download_fbs_invoices. Please note: The download link for the document will expire 30 minutes after being generated.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| batch_download | object | ❌ No |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ start | int64 | | 20250601 | Format YYYYMMDDe.g. 20240101 |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ end | int64 | | 20250601 | Format YYYYMMDDe.g. 20240101 |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ document_type | int32 | | 1 | 1 = Remessa2 = Return3 = Symbolic Return4 = Sale5 = Entrada6 = Symbolic Remessa7 = all |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ file_type | int32 | |  | 1 = xml only2 = pdf only3 = both |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ document_status | int32 | |  | 1= authorized only2= cancelledDefault:&nbsp;If document_status not passed or passed empty, means documents under ALL status (both authorized and cancelled) must be included |

#### Response Parameters

| Name | Type | Sample | Description |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| error | int32 |  | Indicate error type if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| error_msg | string |  | Error messages |
| result_list | object[] |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ request_id | int64 | |  | Unique task identifier that includes one or more tax documents to be downloaded according to the filters sent in the request. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ fail_error | string | |  | Indicate error type if one element hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ fail_message | string | |  | Indicate error details if one element hit error. Empty if no error happened. |

### v2.logistics.get_shipping_parameter

**Method:** `POST`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/logistics/get_shipping_parameter`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/get_shipping_parameter  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/get_shipping_parameter  

**Description:** Use this api to get the parameter "info_needed" from the response to check if the order has pickup or dropoff or no integrate options. This api will also return the addresses and pickup time id options for the pickup method. For dropoff, it can return branch id, sender real name etc, depending on the 3PL requirements. [Please call this API when order status is READY_TO_SHIP or package logistics/fulfillment status is LOGISTICS_READY].  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| package_number | string | ❌ No | OFG134731496217591 | Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. You should't fill the field with empty string when there is't a package number. |

For logistic_id 80003 and 80004, both Regular and JOB shipping methods are supported. If you choose Regular shipping method, please use "tracking_no" to call Init API. If you choose JOB shipping method, please use "sender_real_name" to call Init API. Note that only one of "tracking_no" and "sender_real_name" can be selected. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ dropoff | string[] | | [ ] | Could contain 'branch_id', 'sender_real_name' or 'tracking_no'. If it contains 'branch_id', choose one to Init. If it contains 'sender_real_name' or 'tracking_no', should manually input these values in Init API. If it has empty value, developer should still include "dropoff" field in Init API.Could contain 'slug'.If it contains 'slug', to return selected 3PL partner only for TW C2C sellers to drop-off parcels with. |

Choose one address_id and its corresponding pickup_time_id to Init. ### v2.logistics.ship_order

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/logistics/ship_order`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/ship_order  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/ship_order  

**Description:** Use this api to initiate logistics including arrange pickup, dropoff or shipment for non-integrated logistic channels. Should call v2.logistics.get_shipping_parameter to fetch all required param first. It's recommended to initiate logistics one hour after the orders were placed.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| order_sn | string | ✅ Yes | 201212DCXHJUIKJ | Shopee's unique identifier for an order. |
| package_number | string | ❌ No |  | Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. You should't fill the field with empty string when there is't a package number. |
| pickup | object | ❌ No |  | Required parameter ONLY if get_shipping_parameter returns "pickup" under "info_needed". Developer should still include "pickup" field in the call even if "pickup" has empty value. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ address_id | int64 | |  | The identity of address. Retrieved from v2.logistics.get_shipping_parameter. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pickup_time_id | string | |  | The pickup time id. Retrieved from v2.logistics.get_shipping_parameter, you can only select one from the time_slot_list.&nbsp;Some logistics channels may not return any date or time for pickup time slots. In such cases, sellers can arrange shipment without selecting any time slot, and Shopee will arrange a suitable timing for these situations. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tracking_number | string | |  | Need input this field when "tracking_number" is returned from "info_need". Please note that this tracking number is assigned by third-party shipping carrier for item shipment. |
| dropoff | object | ❌ No |  | Required parameter ONLY if get_shipping_parameter returns "dropoff" under "info_needed". Developer should still include "dropoff" field in the call even if "dropoff" has empty value. For logistic_id 80003 and 80004, both Regular and JOB shipping methods are supported. If you choose Regular shipping method, please use "tracking_no" to call Init API. If you choose JOB shipping method, please use "sender_real_name" to call Init API. Note that only one of "tracking_no" and "sender_real_name" can be selected. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ branch_id | int64 | | 0 | The identity of branch. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ sender_real_name | string | |  | The real name of sender. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tracking_number | string | |  | Need input this field when "tracking_number" is returned from "info_need". Please note that this tracking number is assigned by third-party shipping carrier for item shipment. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ slug | string | |  | The selected 3PL partner to drop-off parcels with. |
| non_integrated | object | ❌ No |  | Optional parameter when get_shipping_parameter returns "non-integrated" under "info_needed". |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tracking_number | string | |  | Optional parameter for non-integrated channel order. The tracking number assigned by the shipping carrier for item shipment. |

#### Response Parameters

| Name | Type | Sample | Description |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| request_id | string | 3dad66f43b8447d282ae6da36626c6b7 | The identifier for an API request for error tracking. |
| error | string | error_auth | Indicate error type if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| message | string | Invalid access_token. | Indicate error details if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |

### v2.logistics.mass_ship_order

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/logistics/mass_ship_order`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/mass_ship_order  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/mass_ship_order  

**Description:** Use this api to initiate logistics including arrange pickup, dropoff or shipment for non-integrated logistic channels. Should call v2.logistics.get_mass_shipping_parameter to fetch all required params first. It's recommended to initiate logistics one hour after the orders were placed since there is one-hour window buyer can cancel any order without request to seller. The API can only batch arrange shipment for multiple packages under the same product_location_id and same logistics_channel_id.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| logistics_channel_id | int64 | ❌ No | 50021 | The API can only batch arrange shipment for multiple packages under the same product_location_id and same logistics_channel_id.&nbsp;Use this field to specify the logistics_channel_id for the request.&nbsp;If not specified, will use the logistics_channel_id corresponds to the first package_number by default. |
| product_location_id | string | ❌ No |  | The API can only batch arrange shipment for multiple packages under the same product_location_id and same logistics_channel_id.&nbsp;Use this field to specify the product_location_id for the request.&nbsp;If not specified, will use the product_location_id corresponds to the first package_number by default. |
| package_list | object[] | ✅ Yes |  | The list of packages you want to arrange shipment. limit [1, 50]. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_number | string | |  | Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. You should't fill the field with empty string when there is't a package number. |
| pickup | object | ❌ No |  | Required parameter ONLY if GetParameterForInit returns "pickup" or if GetLogisticsInfo returns "pickup" under "info_needed" for the same order. Developer should still include "pickup" field in the call even if "pickup" has empty value. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ address_id | int64 | |  | The identity of address. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pickup_time_id | string | |  | The pickup time id.&nbsp;Retrieved from v2.logistics.get_mass_shipping_parameter, you can only select one from the time_slot_list.Some logistics channels may not return any date or time for pickup time slots. In such cases, sellers can arrange shipment without selecting any time slot, and Shopee will arrange a suitable timing for these situations. |
| dropoff | object | ❌ No |  | Required parameter ONLY if GetParameterForInit returns "dropoff" or if GetLogisticsInfo returns "dropoff" under "info_needed" for the same order. Developer should still include "dropoff" field in the call even if "dropoff" has empty value. For logistic_id 80003 and 80004, both Regular and JOB shipping methods are supported. If you choose Regular shipping method, please use "tracking_no" to call Init API. If you choose JOB shipping method, please use "sender_real_name" to call Init API. Note that only one of "tracking_no" and "sender_real_name" can be selected. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ branch_id | int64 | | 0 | The identity of branch. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ sender_real_name | string | |  | The real name of sender. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tracking_number | string | |  | Need input this field when "tracking_number" is returned from "info_need". Please note that this tracking number is assigned by third-party shipping carrier for item shipment. |
| non_integrated | object | ❌ No |  | Optional parameter when get_mass_shipping_parameter returns "non-integrated" under "info_needed". |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tracking_number | object[] | |  | Optional parameter for non-integrated channel order. The tracking number assigned by the shipping carrier for item shipment. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_number | string | |  | Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tracking_number | string | |  | Optional parameter for non-integrated channel order. The tracking number assigned by the shipping carrier for item shipment. |

#### Response Parameters

| Name | Type | Sample | Description |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| request_id | string | 3dad66f43b8447d282ae6da36626c6b7 | The identifier for an API request for error tracking. |
| error | string | error_auth | Indicate error type if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| message | string | Invalid access_token. | Indicate error details if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| success_list | object[] |  | Success package list. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_number | string | |  | Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. |
| fail_list | object[] |  | Fail package list. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_number | string | |  | Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ fail_reason | string | |  | Reason for failure. |

### v2.logistics.get_tracking_number

**Method:** `POST`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/logistics/get_tracking_number`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/get_tracking_number  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/get_tracking_number  

**Description:** After arranging shipment (v2.logistics.ship_order) for the integrated channel, use this api to get the tracking_number, which is a required parameter for creating shipping labels. The api response can return tracking_number empty, since this info is dependent from the 3PL, due to this it is allowed to keep calling the api within 5 minutes interval, until the tracking_number is returned.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| order_sn | string | ✅ Yes | 201214JASXYXY6 | Shopee's unique identifier for an order. |
| package_number | string | ❌ No |  | Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. You should't fill the field with empty string when there isn't a package number. |
| response_optional_fields | string | ❌ No | first_mile_tracking_number | Indicate response fields you want to get. Please select from the below response parameters. If you input an object field, all the params under it will be included automatically in the response. If there are multiple response fields you want to get, you need to use English comma to connect them. Available values: plp_number, first_mile_tracking_number,last_mile_tracking_number |

#### Response Parameters

| Name | Type | Sample | Description |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| request_id | string | 9d07076ffda5407bb7c559f0b82ed91e | The identifier for an API request for error tracking. |
| error | string | error_auth | Indicate error type if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| message | string | Invalid access_token. | Indicate error details if hit error. Empty if no error happened. |
| response | object |  | Detail informations you are querying. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tracking_number | string | | MY200448706479IT | The tracking number of this order. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ plp_number | string | |  | The unique identifier for package of BR correios. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ first_mile_tracking_number | string | | CNF877146678717210312 | The first mile tracking number of the order. Only for Cross Border Seller |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ last_mile_tracking_number | string | | 200448706479IT | The last mile tracking number of the order. Only for Cross Border BR seller. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ hint | string | | Buyers CVS closed， waiting for buyer to reselect another CVS stores，auto cancel time 2021-01-01 | Indicate hint information if cannot get some fields under special scenarios. For example, cannot get tracking_number when cvs store is closed. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pickup_code | string | |  | For drivers to quickly identify parcel to be picked up.&nbsp;Only returned for ID local orders who using instant+sameday for delivery. |

### v2.logistics.download_shipping_document

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/logistics/download_shipping_document`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/download_shipping_document  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/download_shipping_document  

**Description:** Use this api to download shipping_document. You have to call v2.logistics.create_shipping_document to create a new shipping document task first and call v2.logistics.get_shipping_document_resut to get the task status second. If the task is READY, you can download this shipping document.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

|------|------|--------|-------------|
| waybill | file |  | The waybill file. |

### v2.logistics.get_shipping_document_data_info

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/logistics/get_shipping_document_data_info`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/get_shipping_document_data_info  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/get_shipping_document_data_info  

**Description:** Use this api to fetch the logistics information of an order, these info can be used for self-design AWB printing. Besides, this api supports returning personal info as images.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| order_sn | string | ✅ Yes | 201224EM1FMFG1 | Shopee's unique identifier for an order. |
| package_number | string | ❌ No | 9087129345 | Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. You shouldn't fill the field with empty string when there isn't a package number. |
| recipient_address_info | object[] | ❌ No |  | recipient address to query as image |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ key | string | | name | fields to query in the recipient address, should be name, phone, full_address,&nbsp;town,&nbsp;district,&nbsp;city,&nbsp;state,&nbsp;region,&nbsp;zipcode. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ style | object | |  | image style |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ text_style | string[] | | ["bold", "italic"] | supports bold and italic |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ font_size | int32 | | 12 | supports 1 - 108 |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ text_color | string | | #39c5bb | color string like "#AbCd12" |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ image_width | float | | 3.0 | supports 0.1-30, in centimeters |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ h_align | string | | center | text horizontal align, supports left, center and right. |

| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ dely_sun_label | string | | H | Probability of Successful Sunday Delivery.The value of L(low), M(medium), H(high) represent the chances of successful delivery attempts on Sunday. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pickup_code | string | |  | For drivers to quickly identify parcel to be picked up.&nbsp;Only returned for ID and TH local orders which use instant+sameday for delivery. |

**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/get_operating_hour_restrictions  

**Description:** This API is designed to retrieve all restrictions related to inputting operating hours for the v2.logistics.update_operating_hours function. This API ensures that user are aware of any limitations or conditions that may affect their operating hours.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

*No parameters.*

| Name | Type | Sample | Description |

| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ minimum_working_days_in_week | int64 | | 5 | Minimum number of days the seller needs to designate as working days per week (including Monday to Sunday, but excluding public holidays from the count). |

### v2.logistics.update_operating_hours

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/logistics/update_operating_hours`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/update_operating_hours  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/update_operating_hours  

**Description:** This API is designed to allow sellers to update their operating hours. It is essential that the values provided in this API align with the restrictions retrieved from the v2.logistics.get_operating_hour_restrictions API to ensure compliance with platform requirements. This API uses overwriting updates, when updating pickup operating hours, still need to include all parts even those not needing changes.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

### v2.logistics.delete_special_operating_hour

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/logistics/delete_special_operating_hour`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/delete_special_operating_hour  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/delete_special_operating_hour  

**Description:** This API is used to delete a specific special operating hour for a seller. This API allows sellers to manage their operating hours by removing any special operating hours that are no longer needed. To use this API, the name of the special operating hour to be deleted should be obtained from the v2.logistics.get_operating_hours API.

*No common parameters.*

### v2.logistics.batch_update_tpf_warehouse_tracking_status

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/logistics/batch_update_tpf_warehouse_tracking_status`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/batch_update_tpf_warehouse_tracking_status  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/batch_update_tpf_warehouse_tracking_status  

**Description:** For CB orders that fulfilled by 3PF, support 3PF Warehouse Vendors to update the tpf_tracking_status when 3PF warehouse receive the order and complete the outbound of the package. CB orders that fulfilled by 3PF： v2.shop.get_shop_info - shop_fulfillment_flag in {Pure - 3PF Shop,PFF - 3PF Shop,LFF Hybrid Shop} And v2.order.get_order_detail - fulfillment_flag = fulfilled_by_local_seller  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| tpf_name | string | ✅ Yes | Shopee 3PF | The name of 3PF Warehouse Vendor. Prohibit pure numbers and excessive abbreviations. Standardize naming for easy business recognition. Input priority: warehouse English name &gt; full pinyin of warehouse brand name &gt; warehouse Chinese name &gt; other officially recognized and prominent names. |
| tpf_tracking_status | string | ✅ Yes | 3pf_warehouse_outbound_done | The 3PF tracking status for the timestamp. All statuses are in lower case.&nbsp;List of status:&nbsp;- 3pf_warehouse_order_created- 3pf_warehouse_outbound_done |
| package_list | object[] | ✅ Yes |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ order_sn | string | | 2003160SXK2A3T | Shopee's unique identifier for an order. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_number | string | | OFG38027870177402 | Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ update_time | int64 | | 1610000000 | This is to indicate timestamp of the 3PF tracking status.Timestamp should be within order create time and order pick up by 3PL time. |

### v2.logistics.batch_ship_order

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/logistics/batch_ship_order`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/batch_ship_order  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/batch_ship_order  

**Description:** Use this api to batch initiate logistics including arrange pickup, dropoff or shipment for non-integrated logistic channels. Should call v2.logistics.get_shipping_parameter to fetch all required param first. It's recommended to initiate logistics one hour after the orders were placed since there is one-hour window buyer can cancel any order without request to seller.Only channel 90003 - Padrão in Brazil has the permission of this API.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| order_list | object[] | ✅ Yes |  | The list of order. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ order_sn | string | | 201212DCXHJUIKJ | Shopee's unique identifier for an order. Limit 150. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ package_number | string | |  | Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. You should't fill the field with empty string when there is't a package number. |
| pickup | object | ❌ No |  | Required parameter ONLY if GetParameterForInit returns "pickup" or if GetLogisticsInfo returns "pickup" under "info_needed" for the same order. Developer should still include "pickup" field in the call even if "pickup" has empty value. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ address_id | int | |  | The identity of address. Retrieved from shopee.logistics.GetAddress. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ pickup_time_id | string | |  | The pickup time id. Retrieved from shopee.logistics.GetTimeSlot. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tracking_number | string | |  | Need input this field when "tracking_number" is returned from "info_need". Please note that this tracking number is assigned by third-party shipping carrier for item shipment. |
| dropoff | object | ❌ No |  | Required parameter ONLY if GetParameterForInit returns "dropoff" or if GetLogisticsInfo returns "dropoff" under "info_needed" for the same order. Developer should still include "dropoff" field in the call even if "dropoff" has empty value. For logistic_id 80003 and 80004, both Regular and JOB shipping methods are supported. If you choose Regular shipping method, please use "tracking_no" to call Init API. If you choose JOB shipping method, please use "sender_real_name" to call Init API. Note that only one of "tracking_no" and "sender_real_name" can be selected. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ branch_id | int | | 0 | The identity of branch. Retrieved from shopee.logistics.GetBranch branch. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ sender_real_name | string | |  | The real name of sender. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ tracking_number | string | |  | Need input this field when "tracking_number" is returned from "info_need". Please note that this tracking number is assigned by third-party shipping carrier for item shipment. |

### v2.logistics.update_tracking_status

**Method:** `GET`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/logistics/update_tracking_status`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/update_tracking_status  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/update_tracking_status  

**Description:** Only available for Brazil sellers. This API is only available for orders/parcels which are fulfilled by BR Seller Logistics channel (logistics_channel_id: 90021), Samsung (logistics_channel_id: 90025) and BR Instant Delivery channel (logistics_channel_id: 90026). The logistics_status will become LOGISTICS_REQUEST_CREATED after arrange shipment, and can call this API to update to: LOGISTICS_PICKUP_DONE, LOGISTICS_DELIVERY_DONE, LOGISTICS_DELIVERY_FAILED.  

#### Common Parameters

*No common parameters.*

#### Request Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sample | Description |
|------|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| order_sn | string | ✅ Yes | 201212DCXHJUIKJ | Shopee's unique identifier for an order. |
| tracking_number | string | ❌ No | 1234567890 | Order tracking number, might help seller to identify his order on the tracking_URL.Can only be sent when updating logistics_status to "logistic_pickup_done". |
| tracking_url | string | ❌ No | https://tracking_url_order_201212DCXHJUIKJ | Website's URL for order tracking&nbsp;with maximum length of 2048 characters.Can only be sent when updating logistics_status to "logistic_pickup_done". |
| logistics_status | string | ✅ Yes | logistics_pickup_done | Order status update support:- logistics_pickup_done- logistics_delivery_done- logistics_delivery_failed |
| failed_reason | string | ❌ No | buyer_unreachable | Only required when updating logistics_status to "logistics_delivery_failed". Only required for BR Instant Delivery channel (logistics_channel_id: 90026). Only accept the following values.&nbsp;-&nbsp;buyer_unreachable-&nbsp;buyer_unresponsive-&nbsp;no_delivery_location_consensus |

#### Response Parameters

| Name | Type | Sample | Description |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| request_id | string | e9b086380a7dcdc408cb5ebe2cf38041 | API request identifier |
| error | string |  | Error code |
| message | string |  | Error message |
| warning | string |  |  |
| response | object |  | Response body |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ update_result | string | | succeed | Update results:- succeed- failed |

#### Error Codes

| Error | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `logistics.order_not_exist` | The order_sn {order_sn} is not exist. |
| `logistics.invalid_address_version` | Some addresses are no longer supported per new regulation, please update to avoid wrong fulfilment |
| `error_data` | parse data failed |
| `error_data` | data not exist |
| `error_param` | parameter invalid |
| `error_param` | The information you queried is not found. |
| `error_param` | Wrong parameters, detail: {msg}. |

**Method:** `POST`

**Description:** Use this api to get the parameter "info_needed" from the response to check if the booking has pickup or dropoff. This api will also return the addresses and pickup time id options for the pickup method. For dropoff, it can return branch id, sender real name etc, depending on the 3PL requirements.

If it contains 'sender_real_name' or 'tracking_no', should manually input these values in Init API. If it has empty value, developer should still include "dropoff" field in Init API. |

Choose one address_id and its corresponding pickup_time_id to Init. If it has empty value, developer should still include "pickup" field in Init API.It could contains "tracking_number" returned from "info_need"for some channels, please also add it when init. |

### v2.payment.get_payout_detail

**Method:** `POST`  
**Endpoint:** `/api/v2/payment/get_payout_detail`  
**URL:** https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/payment/get_payout_detail  
**Test URL:** https://partner.test-stable.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/payment/get_payout_detail  

**Description:** This API is applicable for Cross Border (CB) sellers only to get the shop's payout data, such as the payout amount, currency, FX rate, the payout's associated order income and adjustment records etc.  

#### Common Parameters
